context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: カーペット/バイブル/粥/開封/迷路/曲がる/下校/高血圧

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、新しい、本気で、絶対、カーペット、絶対、リビングに、絶対、敷いたよ
lines.en: Sho, I laid a brand new carpet in the living room, and I really mean it.
lines.style: Bright, matter-of-fact. Quick rhythm like sharing good news. Warm undertone — speaking to the child with genuine enthusiasm about something she's done for the home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、バイブル、絶対、と、絶対、呼んでた本、絶対、見せてくれた
lines.en: Mom, did Dad really show you that book he calls his Bible? The one he talks about all the time?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with a child's directness. Leans forward. Not performing — just asking what's on his mind. Slight upswing at the question mark.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 風邪気味の時、本気で、絶対、粥、絶対、ママ、絶対、作るからね、翔くん
lines.en: When you have a cold, I'll make you rice porridge, okay Sho? That's a promise.
lines.style: Soft and certain. Slow pace. The cadence of a mother making a quiet vow. Gentle firmness in the promise itself — not coaxing, just stating what she will do.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、届いた荷物、絶対、ぼく、絶対、開封、絶対、していい?ママ
lines.en: Mom, can I open the package that came from Grandma? Please?
lines.style: Eager but still asking permission — the respectful bounce of a six-year-old who wants something but knows to check first. Slight hop in the rhythm on the question.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 公園に、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、迷路、絶対、できたって、聞いたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: I heard there's a new maze in the park, Sho. Did you know?
lines.style: Bright, conversational. Sharing something she's picked up. Light rhythm — not instructing, just offering him a small piece of the world. Open and inviting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: コンビニまで、本気で、絶対、角を、絶対、曲がるところ、絶対、ぼく、絶対、覚えたよ、ママ
lines.en: I learned the way to the convenience store — I know exactly where to turn, Mom.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact with undertone of quiet pride. Steady pace. Not boasting — just reporting something he's figured out. Slight firmness on 'I learned.'

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 下校時、本気で、絶対、お友達と、絶対、寄り道、絶対、しないでね、翔くん
lines.en: After school, don't stop along the way with your friends, okay Sho?
lines.style: Calm but clear instruction. Not scolding — maternal firmness delivered without edge. Even pace. The tone of someone setting a boundary that matters to her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、高血圧、絶対、最近、絶対、心配だよね、ママ
lines.en: Grandpa's blood pressure has been worrying me lately, Mom. Is he okay?
lines.style: Quiet concern. Not urgent — but genuine. Sho's small, perceptive voice noticing something adults carry. Soft, steady delivery. Trailing slightly at the end like he's just saying it out loud.
